visual_dna: Crownless is a playable living medieval manuscript: rough hand-inked and woodcut visuals on parchment, with restrained semantic color. Exploration writes discovered places into the world as visual knowledge rather than presenting generic realistic dark-fantasy concept art.

background.purpose: Represent a discovered Crownless location as a visual memory that can be unlocked and revisited from the exploration journal without becoming a generic cinematic background.

composition.framing: wide environmental location art with one clear landmark and a readable approach path or spatial cue

palette: restrained faded blue-green for discovered knowledge
muted vermilion only when semantically justified
discovery_language: the place should feel newly found rather than fully catalogued
visual detail may suggest age, danger, history and traversal
the landmark must remain readable at mobile size
the image should feel like another page from the same Crownless manuscript
forbidden: characters or creatures unless explicitly requested
text, labels, logos or game UI baked into the image
blackened grimdark treatment that destroys parchment readability
glowing magical spectacle used only for decoration
borrowing composition or location identity from a rejected or unrelated generated candidate
using real-world POI photographs as the location visual

reject_even_if_beautiful_when: the result could belong to another dark-fantasy RPG by swapping the logo
the result becomes photorealistic or painterly
the visual no longer reads as a Crownless manuscript page
the location identity is borrowed from an unrelated candidate instead of the current request and Canon
